name: MHRA approves remibrutinib for urticaria
summary: The MHRA has approved remibrutinib (Rhapsido) tablets for adults with chronic spontaneous urticaria whose symptoms antihistamines do not control well enough.
keyPoints: The MHRA approved remibrutinib (Rhapsido) for adults with chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU).
It is for people whose symptoms are not adequately controlled by antihistamines.
The MHRA cites two main clinical studies involving 925 adults for whom H1 antihistamine treatment did not work well enough.

body.heading: What was announced
body.body: The MHRA says it has approved remibrutinib (Rhapsido) tablets for adults with chronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) whose symptoms are not adequately controlled by antihistamines.

body.heading: What it means
body.body: The MHRA says the decision rests on two main clinical studies involving 925 adults who had not responded well enough to H1 antihistamines.
